content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Atal Awasiya Vidyalaya Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: basti.nic.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 05-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Atal Awasiya Vidyalaya, offering various teaching positions for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q2. What are the post names available?
faq.answer: The available post names for this recruitment are PGT (Post Graduate Teacher) and TGT (Trained Graduate Teacher) in various subjects.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There are a total of 12 vacancies announced for the PGT and TGT posts under the Atal Awasiya Vidyalaya Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Atal Awasiya Vidyalaya PGT and TGT posts is offline. Candidates need to send their applications by post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for candidates to submit their completed application forms for this recruitment is 05 September 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying to these PGT and TGT posts is 50 years as of the specified date.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary range for PGT and TGT posts?
faq.answer: The salary for the PGT and TGT posts ranges from Rs. 34125/- to Rs. 36000/- per month, depending on the specific post.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Atal Awasiya Vidyalaya Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website?
faq.answer: The official website for more details and to download the application form is basti.nic.in, where the notification is available.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process for these posts includes a Merit List, followed by Counseling, an Interview, and Document Verification for shortlisted candidates.
